notes: One Envoy consumes one HPVC controller slot regardless of the number of microinverters behind it.
HPVC requires DPEL enabled and mode Production before writing the Watt production limit.
Max power and Min power are manually configured in the HPVC slot; HPVC does not use the DPEL number entity's native min/max as the installation's operating range.
Renamed entity IDs are supported when Home Assistant registry/device metadata still identifies the DPEL roles.
